title: Chapter 158 Zhao Bangde Leaves
content:
Chapter 158 Zhao Bangde Leaves

Wang Shuo suddenly had a lot of information about this dungeon in his mind.

[Please go to the quartermaster to claim the reward for clearing the dungeon. ]

Wang Shuo sorted out his thoughts carefully and had many ideas in his mind. He could try them one by one when the time came.

But this was not the right time, because a countdown appeared in his mind.

This was the countdown to go to the quartermaster to claim the reward, and it showed that there were only 2 hours left.

"Return."

Wang Shuo hurried out of the cave, then rode on his warhorse and rushed back to the Yellow Wind Valley camp.

"Congratulations, you finally cleared this dungeon." Zhao Bangde smiled, and he was finally free at this time.

After completing this task, he could get rid of his tool status and gain freedom.

How many years!

He almost forgot it himself!

Suddenly gaining freedom, in addition to joy, he also felt a little panic in his heart.

Confusion about the future!

He didn't know what he should do?

There were countless plans, how to find Ban Caiyi, how to travel around the continent, how to open a store, how to go...

There were so many ideas, but at this moment, they all felt boring!

It's like looking for a needle in a haystack, and it's a needle from hundreds of years ago, how can it still be found.

Wang Shuo saw the expression on Zhao Bangde's face constantly changing, and he was puzzled.

"Old Zhao?"

Wang Shuo screamed, interrupting Zhao Bangde's distraction.

"I didn't expect you to get through this dungeon so quickly." Zhao Bangde walked towards Wang Shuo and took out a token in his hand.

"This is the dungeon token of area 27 of the ancient battlefield, which is equivalent to the key of this dungeon. With it, you can control the boss difficulty of the dungeon, the refresh speed of monsters, and the explosion rate of monsters."

Wang Shuo stared at Zhao Bangde with some resentment.

"All of this is under your control, isn't it?"

"I just got this thing, and I can't control it." Zhao Bangde smiled bitterly and curled his lips. "Even if the ultimate boss here grows up and launches a counterattack, I might even be killed."

"So terrible." Wang Shuo showed a surprised look on his face. Fortunately, he took action early, otherwise he might really be killed by Mira.

As he said, Wang Shuo looked at Mira with ill intentions.

The latter's skin shrank and curled up into a ball.

"My mission is also completed. It's time to say goodbye!"

"Old Zhao, don't, if you leave, who can I find to exchange items?"

"Uh, yes, I almost forgot how many military merit points you have now?" Zhao Bangde smiled awkwardly and then opened the query panel.

"It's 310,000, not bad. I will exchange the most important item in this copy for you."

[Resource Exchange Stone: You can use energy crystals or soul crystals to exchange items in the list. Each exchange will charge a certain handling fee. After accumulating enough, it can be upgraded to display more exchangeable items. 】

"Oh my god, this thing is awesome!"

Wang Shuo was delighted.

The exchange stone was only the size of a palm at this time. According to past experience, as long as a good place is found, its shape should change.

"Then we say goodbye!" Zhao Bangde bowed to Wang Shuo.

This was the first time he saluted Wang Shuo.

"See you later!" Wang Shuo also bowed solemnly to Zhao Bangde.

If it weren't for Zhao Bangde, Wang Shuo might have died in this cruel trial game.

This bow was from the bottom of Wang Shuo's heart, hoping that this old friend would have a good journey.

In the blink of an eye, Zhao Bangde disappeared in front of him.
